What you are reviewing

Ivory / charcoal surfaces, existing berry identity, consistent sans wordmark treatment, a clearer homepage search, in-flow install guidance, a compact secondary menu and the same loading canvas as the destination.

Desktop, tablet and mobile canvases are responsive design previews—not physical iPhone, Android or installed-PWA certification. Existing Marketplace and Discover layouts remain the benchmark. Final brand-asset choice and major UI changes require your approval.
